requirement.evidence: It shall be unlawful and a violation of the “New Jersey Antitrust Act,” P.L.1970, c.73 (C.56:9-1 et seq.) for:
requirement.note: Document bans owners from using coordinator services (4a), performing a coordinating function (4e), and parallel pricing coordination (4c); AG complaint location is in section 7. Card paraphrase is fair, though 'using competitors' nonpublic data' simplifies the definition.

key_value.evidence: a.     a rental property owner, or any agent, representative, or subcontractor thereof, to receive, subscribe to, contract for, or otherwise exchange any form of consideration in return for the use of, the services of a coordinator;
key_value.note: Ban on using and providing coordination services as violation of the NJ Antitrust Act is stated in section 4.

effective_date.evidence: 9.    This act shall take effect on the first day of the twelfth month next following the date of enactment.
effective_date.note: Enactment is approved July 20, 2026; the twelfth month next following is July 2027, so 2027-07-01 follows by a small computation. The document does not state the calendar date, and the card explains the computation.

status.evidence: 9.    This act shall take effect on the first day of the twelfth month next following the date of enactment.
status.note: As of 2026-10-01, before the computed July 2027 effective date, not_yet_effective follows from the text; the document doesn't state status explicitly.

coverage.note: Coverage is null on the card.

citation.note: The document supports P.L. 2026, c.43 and A3497 ACS (First Reprint), and the C.56:9-20 to 56:9-26 header range for sections 1-7. However, 'N.J.S.A.' is not used in the document, and the codification range appears only in the header.
